title: Rav Dovid Batzri Hospitalized
body: Rav Dovid Batzri, 85, rosh yeshiva of Yeshivas HaShalom in Yerushalayim, hospitalized at Hadassah Ein Kerem Hospital after being transferred from Bnei Brak. Davening requested for his recovery.

title: Jews Hold Childhood Faith
body: Jews are among US adults most likely to retain their childhood faith, with 76% continuing to identify with the religion, a new Pew survey finds, mirroring similar retention rates among Hindus, Muslims, and Protestants.

title: Satmar Rebbe Secures Prison Deal
body: Satmar Rebbe hosts federal prison chief, securing commitments for Jewish inmates at Otisville Correctional Facility in New York.
